Demo Workspace · demo app

This page is a stand-in for your app. Its buttons call a fake API, and the real RESTless code (this build) captures every call in the panel.

Things to try
  • Open a request: edit Query, untick a row, press Run.
  • Open several requests: each gets a tab; ⋯ → Duplicate opens another.
  • Filters: Methods (pick several) and More filters → Errors. The failed calls (400, 403, 500): Pretty explains the error.
  • Simulate in the Response header (pick Error · 500, then Apply), and Compare ▾ → Previous call.
  • The wifi button in the panel's header takes this tab offline: the app's calls fail until you click ● Offline again.
  • The Where & as chip in the panel's header lists each environment with its own users. Add an environment and drag a user onto it.
  • API Docs tab: hover an endpoint and click Mock to answer it without the server (listed under Rules → Mock endpoints).
  • Open GET /api/admin/audit → ⋯ → Run & simulate → Run as every user: on Default, Admin gets 200, Viewer 403. Open POST /api/tasks → ⋯ → Testing & debugging → Test edge cases.
  • API Docs tab: the demo's API (Projects, Tasks, Users, Reports, Admin) is already loaded. Try an endpoint, or load other docs by URL or JSON.
